newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Noven upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Noven upgraded to buy.

text.p: Rodman & Renshaw said analyst James Keeney raised his rating on Noven Pharmaceuticals Inc to buy from neutral.
-- said upgrade based on a likely pickup in sales of the company's transdermal patches in the 1997 second quarter compared with the 1996 quarter.
-- said expects stock price to be bolstered by forthcoming positive announcements about regulatory filings and licensing agreements.
-- said expects company's second-quarter earnings per share to reflect a loss of about $0.10, but expects company to return to profitablilty during the second half of 1997.
